|lore=Modified medium transport. Well armored. Has expanded passenger capacity to facilitate evacuation. The last transport to escape Hoth. Nearly destroyed by the ''Stalker''.
|game_text=May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While in battle with another Rebel capital starship, may cancel a just drawn battle destiny.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Bright Hope (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 1, slip 5 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While in battle with another Rebel capital starship, may cancel a just drawn battle destiny.” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. Stats line: “POWER 3 ARMOR 4 HYPERSPEED 5”. Deploy 2, forfeit 5. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•5” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-05-Bright_Hope-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bright Hope (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 5), in the Committee's Remaster template: “May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, if with a Rebel capital starship, may use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
